t: r/HomeImprovement on Reddit: I'm looking to buy a bathtub. Any advice on where to shop?
s: March 19, 2013 - See if there are any stores that sell reclaimed construction stuff from demo'd builings in your area. We have a few in the Portland area, and I know one of them always has some big, antique, cast iron, claw foot kind of tubs. They aren't exactly cheap, but they are awesome, and they won't lose value much since you are already buying it used!
